name: Synthetic 396-label contract clause corpus

compatibility.integration: Separate 396-label experimental classifier task; do not merge classifier heads.

provenance: User supplied; generation method, author, source inputs, and model/version were not included.
publication: Raw files and archive are Git-ignored pending documented redistribution rights.
workbench_policy: All 396 labels are available through an explicit experimental opt-in. Template fingerprints replace absent contract IDs for grouped splitting. Supplied train/validation/test boundaries are retained only as metadata and are not trusted for evaluation.
limitations: Synthetic text is not an independent real-contract holdout.
Exact duplicates, conflicting labels, template reuse, and label-name leakage can inflate metrics.
Template grouping reduces but cannot prove elimination of semantic leakage.
Use unchanged real CUAD or another independently sourced, licensed real-contract holdout for comparison.
